name: Dynamic Voxelization (Coordinate Only)
definition: Computes only the voxel coordinates for each point, without assigning points to a fixed voxel grid structure or handling duplicates/max points. Used when max_points=-1.
summary: Dynamic Voxelization (Coordinate Only) maps point cloud coordinates to voxel indices without merging duplicates or aggregating features, serving as a fast, low-memory pre-processing step for 3D object detection.
